output.review_comment: Request changes: (1) Add a PR description explaining which tests were failing and how the fix addresses them. (2) Provide evidence that the full test suite passes. (3) The new mixed case preservation logic needs clarification - is this part of the spec agreed with the editorial team, or is it test-specific logic? The original code didn't preserve mixed case, so this is a significant behavioral change that requires justification. Without seeing the tests and test results, I cannot verify this implementation is correct.
